subject: namespace clash between Biobase and ggplot2

messages.author: 52e73b2030a3e651
messages.subject: namespace clash between Biobase and ggplot2
parts:
For a while now, I'd been wondering why qplot() would sometimes stop working when I had a microarray dataset loaded.  After writing a class that uses both Biobase and ggplot2, I don't wonder anymore; I realized that the function plyr::dims is masked by Biobase::dims.

Would it break anything if I made the namespace for calls to plyr::dims explicit in plyr & ggplot2?  I guess there is one way to find out :-)

With regard to git and SVN-style merging, what was the verdict?  (i.e., where should I make any changes for consideration in ''HEAD'' ?)
